name: Writer
about: Idea and hero → the Writer writes the scenes at the «Write» button, «Expand into scenes» builds prompts, scenes, a join and an output.

data.text:
Writer.

1. Type the idea into the «Idea» node.
2. In the «Hero» — a photo and «Describe from photo», or the look by hand (the hero can be deleted — the video will have no people).
3. «Write» on the Writer, then «Expand into scenes».
